set.body:
Goal: re-express the paired family — PLSC, regularized CCA, reduced-rank regression — through secondOrder/compress, delete PairedGmd as a private third engine, and unify all three on FunctionalFrame. Design: docs/plans/multivar-operator-core.md §7, §10 (Phase 3).

PairedLatent already treats xWeights/yWeights as the primary parameter with scores derived — make those the FunctionalFrame directly. The cross operator is S_XY = secondOrder(x, L_XY, y); partial row matching is just the L (S_XY = Xˢ P_Xˢ A_E P_Y Y), so nothing in the CCA/PLS program knows whether the match was complete, partial, or weighted. The CCA-vs-PLS distinction is a normalization choice, not a separate engine: CCA normalizes by observed covariance (W_X' S̃_XX W_X = I), PLS by declared feature geometry (W_X' Q_X W_X = I). RRR keeps the directed coefficient map as a derived object.

Acceptance: PairedLatentRReferenceFixtures pass UNCHANGED on JVM+JS; PairedGmd/PairedGmdMetric deleted from production; PLSC/CCA/RRR share the primitives and return FunctionalFrame-based fits; CcaRegularization/RegressionRegularization remain typed (no raw doubles across the API); `sbt testAll` green.
set.title: Multivar: re-express PLSC/CCA/RRR through the primitives; delete PairedGmd; unify on FunctionalFrame
